name: send_message
description: Send text to one or more participants by ID. Each call submits one message and returns a submission reference; acceptance does not confirm delivery.

name: fork_session
description: Transfer this activation's work to a new child with the retained working context, and return its stable session_id. The caller returns to its queue; unadmitted events and existing callbacks keep their destinations. Child results are reported automatically to the caller and core. At most one fork per model round.

task.description: Task and continuation instructions for the activation's whole work.

name: send_session_message
description: Queue an observation or coordination message for an existing session, with your session recorded as its source. A dormant recipient becomes ready; a running recipient admits it between complete model/tool rounds. Success confirms durable queue acceptance.

session_id.description: Recipient session ID from current state, a fork, or retained history.

name: wakeup
description: Schedule one observation for this session at a Unix time in milliseconds, and return its callback_id. The arrangement survives restart. Past times are immediately due; delivery and inference may occur later than the requested time. Return control when ready to let this session sleep.

at_unix_ms.description: Unix time in milliseconds. Current runtime time is supplied in state.

text.description: What to reconsider when this observation arrives.
